name: Gluckserhütte
beschreibung: The Gluckserhütte in Tulfes is a holiday apartment in a quiet location on the edge of the village. The accommodation offers space for up to four people and is equipped with a fully equipped kitchen. From the balcony there is a view of the surrounding mountains of the Tiroler Unterland. In the surrounding area there are numerous hiking trails for summer and ski areas for winter. The nearby farm of the landlord supplies fresh regional products. The city of Innsbruck can be reached by car in about 20 minutes.
